description: Verify that the Client ID of the notification is 0x0000
approach:
[Objective]
This case asserts a single SOME/IP-SD wire-format invariant: Client ID must equal 0x0000. The harness drives DUT to emit a qualifying notification, captures it, and validates the field byte-precisely.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester drives DUT to emit a notification (typically by completing OfferService prelude or sending a stimulus message).
2. Observation: captured notification's Client ID == 0x0000   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Client ID on the wire equals 0x0000.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_client_id — Client ID nonzero
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying notification within the listen window

verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying notification within listen window
